description_en: Submits a task to generate a 3D digital human video from a WAV audio file. This operation immediately returns a TaskUuid as the unique ID for the task. You can use the TaskUuid to query or cancel the task later
description_zh: 提交根据一段wav音频文件生成3D数字人视频任务，该接口会立即返回一个TaskUuid作为本次提交任务的唯一id，后续可以根据TaskUuid调用查询和取消任务接口
kebab_example: aliyun avatar submit-audio-to-3d-avatar-video-task --tenant-id 1 --app AppId=3d95xx946a --title '这是一个示例标题' --url '可访问的公网url地址' --region cn-hangzhou
name: SubmitAudioTo3DAvatarVideoTask

parameters.help_en: The tenant ID. Obtain this ID from the Digitized Virtual Human Open Platform
parameters.help_zh: 租户ID，从虚拟数字人开放平台中获取的TenantId
parameters.name: tenant_id

fields.help_en: The app ID. Obtain the app ID on the Instance Management page in the Developer Center. For more information, see this document (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/479093.html?spm=a2c4g.447644.0.0.406f66c95dI2Ee#6a48daa1ee899)
fields.help_zh: App ID。在开发者中心-实例管理页面获取对应的appId，参考文档 (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/479093.html?spm=a2c4g.447644.0.0.406f66c95dI2Ee#6a48daa1ee899)
fields.name: app_id

parameters.help_en: The application information, which represents a business configuration
parameters.help_zh: App信息，代表一个业务配置
parameters.name: app

parameters.help_en: The title of the video synthesis task. The title can be up to 32 characters long
parameters.help_zh: 提交的视频合成的任务标题，最长不超过32个字符
parameters.name: title

fields.help_en:
The format of the alpha channel. The default value is 1.

1: webm

2: mov

3: mp4

<notice>

This parameter is ignored if \`IsAlpha\` is set to \`false\`. The MOV format creates very large transparent video files. Use the WebM or MP4 format instead.

</notice>
fields.help_zh:
透明通道格式 ，默认值1

1：webm
2：mov
3：mp4

<notice>当isAlpha为false时，该字段忽略。mov格式的透明视频文件大小会非常大，不推荐使用，建议使用webm或者mp4。></notice>
fields.name: alpha_format

fields.help_en:
A valid and accessible URL of the background image. The resolution of the background image must be the same as that of the generated video.

Supported image formats are JPG, JPEG, and PNG
fields.help_zh:
有效可访问的url背景图片地址，背景图片的分辨率必须要与生成的视频分辨率保持一致
目前支持jpg，jpeg，png的图片格式
fields.name: background_image_url

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the alpha channel. The default value is false.

\`true\`: Enables the alpha channel. You can use the \`AlphaFormat\` parameter to specify the video format. Supported formats are webm, mov, and mp4.

\`false\`: Disables the alpha channel. The video format is mp4
fields.help_zh:
是否需要透明通道， 默认false

true： 开启透明通道，视频格式可通过AlphaFormat指定，支持webm、mov、mp4
false：不开启透明通道，视频格式为mp4
fields.name: is_alpha

fields.help_en:
The resolution of the generated video. The following resolutions are supported:

1: 720 × 1280 (portrait)

2: 1280 × 720 (landscape)

3: 1080 × 1920 (portrait)

4: 1920 × 1080 (landscape)
fields.name: resolution

fields.help_en:
The angle of the digital human.

0: Front. This is the default angle.

1: 30 degrees to the left

2: 30 degrees to the right

For a preview of each angle, see: 3D digital human video synthesis user guide (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/447834.html#a989eb5075t9y)
fields.help_zh:
数字人角度

0: 正面，默认角度
1: 左侧30度
2: 右侧30度

具体每个角度的效果预览可以参考：3D数字人视频合成使用指南 (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/447834.html#a989eb5075t9y)
fields.name: angle

fields.help_en:
The code of the digital human.
<warning>The audio synthesis feature currently supports only the following digital humans: Bonnie, Stella, Daisy, and any new digital humans created based on them.></warning>
fields.help_zh:
人物code
<warning>目前音频合成功能只支持部分人物：Bonnie、Stella、Daisy，以及基于这三个人物新建的数字人。></warning>
fields.name: code

fields.help_en:
The industry code. The default value is \`default\`.

default: General

kefu: Customer service

live: Live streaming
fields.help_zh:
行业code，默认值：default
default - 默认通用
kefu - 客服行业
live - 直播场景
fields.name: industry_code

fields.help_en:
The camera position for the digital human.

0: Full-body close-up shot. This is the default position.

1: Head close-up shot

2: Full-body long shot

3: Half-body close-up shot

4: Half-body long shot

5: Left close-up shot

6: Right close-up shot

For a preview of each camera position, see: 3D digital human video synthesis user guide (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/447834.html#9c8a96707515k)
fields.help_zh:
数字人机位
0: 全身近景机位，默认机位
1: 头部近景机位
2: 全身远景机位
3: 半身近景机位
4: 半身远景机位
5: 左边近景机位
6: 右边近景机位

具体每个机位的效果预览可以参考：3D数字人视频合成使用指南 (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/447834.html#9c8a96707515k)
fields.name: locate

parameters.help_en: The configuration of the digital human
parameters.name: avatar_info

parameters.help_en: The URL of the audio file. The audio file must be less than 30 minutes in duration, have a sample rate of 16 kHz, be single-channel, and have a bit depth of 16 bits
parameters.help_zh: 音频的地址url，要求音频时长小于30分钟，采样率16K，单声道，单采样点位深16bit
parameters.name: url

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to receive event callbacks for the video synthesis task. The default value is \`false\`. The platform can send callbacks when a task starts and when it ends. For more information, see Digital human callback notifications (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2261152.html?spm=a2c4g.447644.0.0.406f5876hRJTVU)
parameters.help_zh: 本次视频合成任务是否需要事件回调，默认false不回调。平台支持在任务开始和任务结束时进行事件回调，具体可参考文档：数字人回调事件通知 (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2261152.html?spm=a2c4g.447644.0.0.406f5876hRJTVU)
parameters.name: callback

parameters.help_en: The parameters that you want to pass through in the callback. This parameter must be a JSON string. This parameter is invalid if \`Callback\` is set to \`false\`
parameters.help_zh: 回调时需要透传的一些参数，json格式字符串，callback=false时不生效
parameters.name: callback_params

fields.help_en: The audio sampling rate of the output. Unit: Hz
fields.help_zh: 输出音频采样率（单位: Hz）
fields.name: sample_rate

TaskUuid.description_en: The unique UUID of the task. Save this UUID. You can use it to query the task details later
TaskUuid.description_zh: 任务唯一uuid，后续用来查询任务详细请，请务必保存好

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful
